subject.title: Proof stack for generated media wake-false fallback

question: Should this draft remain a proof-only stack, become the combined landing boundary, or close after proof is captured elsewhere?
rationale: The branch intentionally crosses the split implementation and proof-harness boundaries, and automation cannot decide whether maintainers want that boundary changed.

options.title: Keep Proof-Only Stack
options.body: Keep this draft open only for live proof capture, then land the implementation and proof harness through their separate PRs.

options.title: Adopt Combined Boundary
options.body: Maintainers can intentionally merge this stack if they want one combined landing and accept the bundled delivery and automation risk.

options.title: Close After Alternate Proof
options.body: Close this draft once the same proof is captured against the split PRs or maintainers decide the proof runner cannot exercise this scenario.

recommendation.title: Keep Proof-Only Stack
recommendation.body: Keep this draft open only for live proof capture, then land the implementation and proof harness through their separate PRs.

likelyOwner.reason: This decision is mostly about Telegram/Mantis proof-runner reliability and landing boundary, where recent history points strongest to this owner.
